g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
Observed at +0.15407896041870117s — page 6
- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A persona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answ
ers 404, never 403: the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.
- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still referen
ce this persona: deleting it would strand them.
- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-persona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the person
a by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.
- [Draft personas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and p
ersists nothing; save the ones you want with the create routes. There is no idempotency key, and retries return different drafts.
- [Draft journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and
persists nothing. See `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.
- [Get a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)
- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the re
sponse says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they executed, so their history stays readable.
- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md): Editing a goal never disturbs a run alread
y under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.
- [List swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)
- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFA
ULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts nothing.
- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)
- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored u
nder it are not touched: they keep their own definitions and stay launchable.
- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the container's DEFAULTS. Goals alread
y authored under it keep the values they were created with: this is not a cascade.
- [List journeys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goal
s are excluded.
- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuing a tas
k against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate`: that rou
te persists nothing.
- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's credentials as METADATA ONLY: no va
lue is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own personal ones; another member's
personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.
- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can gran
t it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only.
Creating a project-shared secret requires project admin; a personal one does not.
- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One secret's metadata: delivery mode, host bindin
g, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from another project (and another member's personal se
cret) both read as 404.
- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD: the row a
nd the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops delivering it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: ref
using would leave a leaked credential undeletable until someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wai…
- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/
or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUNS ONLY: a session already running holds the old value (materialized in it
s box's environment, or inside an egress policy that cannot be read back) and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.
- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records
: `attempts` is on the single-run read.
- [Launch a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists an
d its fan-out has started. It is not finished. Poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.
- [Get a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-sessi
on `attempts` and `targetSummaries`.
- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entry per chat session th
e run produced. Summaries, not transcripts. Read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.
- [Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request
and returns immediately. cleanupPending indicates that attempts are being settled in the background; status remains the current s
tored run status. IDEMPOTENT: cancelling an already-cancelled run answers 200 with `alreadyCanceled: true` and `finalized: 0`, not
- [Project swarm roll-up](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/project-swarm-roll-up.md): Recent runs with their g
oal-completion rates and repeat-failure findings, plus a project-wide trend. Deterministic and free. Start here.
- [Get a run's rubric scorecard](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/get-a-runs-rubric-scorecard.md): The determi
nistic rubric result for one run. No model, no spend.
- [List swarm findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/list-swarm-findings.md): Criteria that keep failing,
tracked across waves. One finding is one problem OVER TIME: `occurrenceCount` and `status` carry the history, so do not treat repe
at appearances as separate problems.
- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-insights/dismiss-a-finding.md): Hides a finding from your view.
ORTHOGONAL to `status`: dismissing does not claim the problem stopped happening, and a dismissed finding that fires again stays `r
ecurring`.
